parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const uid = $('Check Status & Extract').first().json.uid; if (!uid) return JSON.stringify([{ '$limit': 0 }]); return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { visitType: 'FIRST_VISIT', '$expr': { '$eq': [{ '$toString': '$patient' }, uid] } } }, { '$sort': { createdAt: 1 } }, { '$project': { _id: 0, visitType: 1, createdAt: 1, updatedAt: 1, report: { '$ifNull': ['$report', null] }, status: 1, cancellationReason: 1, rescheduledFrom: 1, rescheduledTo: 1, cancellationDetails: 1 } }]); })() }}

={{ (()=>{ const wv = $('Find Web Visitor').first().json; const wvId = wv && wv._id ? String(wv._id) : null; if (!wvId) return JSON.stringify([{ '$limit': 0 }]); return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { '$expr': { '$eq': ['$visitor_id', { '$toObjectId': wvId }] } } }, { '$sort': { ts: 1 } }]); })() }}

={{ (() => { const p = String(($('Check Status & Extract').first().json || {}).phone10 || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const s = (p.length === 12 && p.startsWith('91')) ? p.slice(2) : ((p.length === 11 && p.startsWith('0')) ? p.slice(1) : p); if (s.length !== 10) return JSON.stringify([{ '$limit': 0 }]); return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { phone: { '$in': [s, '91' + s, '0' + s] } } }, { '$limit': 1 }]); })() }}
